about: The voice partner's pack and lookups (crates/core/src/voice). scrub: in, deny ("~HOME~" is the home folder), out. pack: sources, sections, then has / lacks on the pack's text and max on its size. closest: the name a heard one matches, or null. pages: page_text of html. private: an address and whether fetch_page refuses it. secret_names: a file name and whether read_file refuses it for its name.

scrub.in: the token budget is 40k and the password reset page is live
scrub.out: the token budget is 40k and the password reset page is live

scrub.what: a key with a known prefix
a random token in no known format
a private key block goes whole
scrub.in:
before
-----BEGIN OPENSSH PRIVATE KEY-----
b3BlbnNzaC1rZXktdjEAAAAA
AAAAbm9uZQ
-----END OPENSSH PRIVATE KEY-----
after

scrub.out: the login lives in [withheld path] now

scrub.what: a file in a denied folder
a denied path in its ~ form
